properties.title: Finland’s Stubb warns Europe not to ‘overreact’ to Russian threats and sabotage
properties.description: NEW YORK — Finnish President Alexander Stubb has a message to European partners amid growing warnings of further Russian escalation: Keep calm and carry on. In recent days, top European officials have ever-more-loudly sounded the alarm about intensifying Russian hybrid warfare, with Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk warning that Moscow could send drones or missiles into the territory of NATO countries supporting Ukraine in “the next few months.” The head of the Czech security service warned that Russia could undertake “a limited incursion, false-flag provocations, a massive influence campaign” in a matter of “months, not years.” Yet Stubb has a different message. properties.title: European leaders prepare public for ‘intensified threat’ from Putin
properties.description: BRUSSELS — Top European officials are increasingly alarmed that Russia could stage drone or missile attacks against NATO countries as Moscow steps up its hybrid campaign across the continent.  Germany is preparing hospitals for a possible conflict , Lithuania has updated evacuation plans and NATO troops are exercising in the Baltic region, while Belarusian forces have staged large maneuvers near Lithuania. On Thursday, Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk warned Moscow could send drones or missiles into the territory of NATO countries supporting Ukraine in “the next few months.” The warnings underscore a growing sense of anxiety in Europe amid fast-proliferating incidents of airspace violations and sabotage attempts in recent months. properties.title: Germany to send fighter jets to Latvia during election amid drone threat
properties.description: BERLIN — Germany will deploy Eurofighter jets to Latvia to help protect its airspace during next month’s parliamentary election as repeated drone incursions have raised security concerns along NATO’s eastern flank. Four German Eurofighters will be sent to the Lielvārde Air Base in central Latvia for about a week from late September into early October, Germany’s defense ministry said Wednesday. The ministry added that Latvia had requested additional support from its NATO allies to secure its airspace ahead of the Oct. 3 vote. The Latvian defense ministry did not immediately respond to POLITICO’s request for comment.  Latvia has experienced several drone incidents this year. properties.title: Russian drone found off Poland’s coast carried explosive warhead, prosecutor says
properties.description: The Russian drone found Monday off Poland’s northwestern coast was carrying a warhead with a detonator, prosecutors handling the case announced Wednesday. On Monday, the Polish military located and retrieved a drone ⁠from the Baltic Sea near the beach in Rusinowo, close ​to Jarosławiec. Authorities neutralized the Russian Gerbera 2 drone on the beach and then moved it for further examination. The aircraft contained a “high-explosive fragmentation warhead fitted with a fuze,” Colonel Bartosz Okoniewski, deputy regional prosecutor for military affairs in Poznań, said in a televised briefing Wednesday. properties.title: US exposes alleged Russian terror network targeting Ukraine allies
properties.description: U.S. prosecutors have charged five people allegedly working for Russian intelligence with conspiracy to finance terrorism and, in three cases, conspiracy to commit murder for hire. The charges, unveiled on Tuesday, also allege that the network recruited operatives to conduct surveillance and killings in the U.S., and to attack civilian and military infrastructure in European countries which are aligned — or perceived to be aligned — with Ukraine. All five defendants remain at large. The indictment says the group most recently approached a U.S.-based individual to surveil and kill a prominent Russian dissident living in the country. properties.title: NATO jets shoot down drone over Lithuania
properties.description: The drone, which is believed to have entered Lithuanian airspace from Belarus, was shot down by an Italian fighter jet in between the cities of Vilnius and Kaunas. There have been no reports of casualties or damage.

properties.title: Tuesday briefing: How to understand Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland’s joint call for change
properties.description: <p>In today’s newsletter: Plaid Cymru, the SNP and Sinn Féin have signed an agreement for greater powers, as pressure grows on Westminster over the UK’s future</p><p>Good morning. Back in May, the shape of British politics shifted dramatically.
